visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Let Autoboxing Do the Conversions
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Integer.valueOf and intValue are called by hand when adding to and reading from a list. Rely on autoboxing and a for-each loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The compiler inserts the boxing and unboxing calls itself, so the code reads as if the list held plain ints. Just remember that unboxing a null Integer throws a NullPointerException.
